name: NeoWorld-10K v0.1 (1,324 articulated, simulation-ready 3D objects)
summary: CC BY 4.0 dataset of articulated household 3D assets (v0.1: 1,324 objects of a planned 10,000) across 19 domains. Each object ships a textured GLB, USDZ, URDF kinematic tree, native .blend, part meshes, joint/axis/limit annotations and four-view renders. Assets are synthetic: reconstructed by the NeoWorld-3 pipeline from generated images, then checked with geometry/articulation tests and human review. Useful for simulation, robotics and interactive props.

access.notes: Attribution required (cite NeoWorld-3 paper). Ungated on Hugging Face; also mirrored on ModelScope. Synthetic assets reconstructed from generated images; physics tests are simulated, not real-world.

procedure: Open the Hugging Face dataset page (or the ModelScope mirror).
Browse objects/<object_id>/ and download object.glb, object.usdz, object.urdf with parts/, or articulation.blend.
For the whole set use huggingface-cli download Doxi-AI/NeoWorld-10K --repo-type dataset (about 153 GB).

stats.cadence: v0.1 2026-11-23; more assets in later updates

verdict.why: Fresh (HF repo created 2026-11-23), large CC BY 4.0 set of editable articulated objects with GLB/USDZ/URDF/.blend per object, ungated; download verified. Synthetic/AI-reconstructed origin and research-leaning focus noted.
